name: Prism Feathered Grove
description: A grove of trees whose leaves are delicate prisms; birds with feathered wings of light flutter, scattering rainbows through the canopy.
prompt: Sunlit grove: trees with leaves shaped like tiny triangular prisms, refracting light into miniature rainbows. Birds with translucent, prism‑like feathers fly, leaving trails of color. Forest floor dappled with spectral spots. 8k, vibrant, magical realism.
caption: Every flutter paints the air. 🌈🕊️ #PrismFeatheredGrove
